description: From the Bund Bull on Zhongshan East 1st Road: south along the Bund, Nanjing Road, Jing'an Temple, Huaihai Road and Xintiandi, Xizang South Road to the Huangpu riverside, the Bansongyuan Road out-and-back, the riverside greenway, the West Bund and Longteng Avenue with its creek bridges and two out-and-backs, Longhua Temple, and the finish at Shanghai Stadium in Xujiahui. Flat; the only relief is modelled bridge humps. Unofficial.

name: Shanghai Marathon

joins.reason: The Huangpu riverside greenway's end by the Xizang South Road tunnel to Longhua East Road: OSM maps no path across the 100 m plaza between them

source.notes: Modelled on the 2025 course: the street sequence from the Shanghai police's 2025 traffic notice, traced over OpenStreetMap streets (the 2026 notice and course map appear about a week before the 6 December race). There is no public certificate or route file, and the southern turnaround's position on Longteng Avenue is estimated from the course length. No open elevation data measures Shanghai's ground: the course is modelled as flat, with 2 m humps at its six creek-bridge crossings (five on Longteng Avenue, one on Wanping South Road). Unofficial.
